violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: YOGURT MIX AT 44F IN MULTIPLEX 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOOD DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over COUNTER/CART USED TO STORE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS at the NEAR DRIVE THRU CASHIER STATION where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED COUNTER/CART DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: MUTLIPLEX 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATOR AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD TCS FOOD FROM UNIT DURING INSPECTION. PIC REQUESTED SERVICE DURING INSPECTION. DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOOD TEMPERATURES AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO RELOCATE EQUIPMENT AND CLEAN AREA DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the: BASE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPLACE DAMAGED DOOR SWEEP AND EMAIL EHS ONCE REPLACED.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped COCKROACH OBSERVED IN BACK KITCHEN AREA. EHS OBSERVED LICENSED PEST CONTROL SERVICE REPORTS FOR APRIL AND MAY 2025.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED PEST DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE SEAL ALL POINTS OF ENTRY.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: BEVERAGE AIR 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER UNIT WITH DOOR HANGING AND UNABLE TO CREATE SEAL TO CLOSE UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED. MONITOR UNIT AND BULK MILK STORED IN UNIT TO ENSURE FOOD TEMPERATURE IS MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system ON MOP SINK FAUCET WITH HOSE CONNECTED TO CHEMICAL SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR THE APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE INSTALLED..
